record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set MAXLEN=64 and LR=6e-4, retaining width 64, two blocks, two heads and dropout 0.1. Most histories fit within 64 positions; shorter attention should reduce computation, while the modestly lower learning rate may stabilize optimization after removing long contexts. Preserve features, embedding tying/radius, interaction/readout and loss. Keep seeds, 200-epoch cap and 200 batches per epoch fixed; synchronize checkpoint metadata and predictor construction.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, jointly reduce maximum history length to 64 and learning rate to 6e-4. Shorter attention reduces computation while the lower learning rate may stabilize optimization with truncated context. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor construction propagate MAXLEN consistently. Preserve all other model, feature, loss and training settings.
